# Notes

- Repository tracks analysis notes and tooling for the PlayStation 2 version of Ford Racing 2.
- Game media, extracted assets, downloaded tools, scratch data, and Ghidra project state stay local and are excluded from version control.
- Use child issues for research, prototypes, grilling, and implementation tasks; link them as GitHub sub-issues when available.

# Decisions so far

- GitHub Issues is the project issue tracker.
- Triage labels: `needs-triage`, `needs-info`, `ready-for-agent`, `ready-for-human`, and `wontfix`.
- Wayfinder labels use the `wayfinder:` prefix.

# Fog

- No scoped reverse-engineering milestones have been captured yet.

# Tickets

_No child issues yet._
